items.doc: David N. Baker SI-NEA oral history (2)
items.title: David N. Baker — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I can remember – and I remind him, now that he’s affluent, of he and [his wife] Margie hitchhiking into town at Tanglewood.

ctx.x: That was when you were at the Lenox School of Jazz?

At the Lenox School of Jazz. Gunther didn’t drive then, nor does he drive now. So I can remember – and I remind him, now that he’s affluent, of he and [his wife] Margie hitchhiking into town at Tanglewood. I can remember Edwin and George, when they were babies.
